relationships.source_independent_definition: A deal concerns one or more operating companies, assets, or legally defined perimeters.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Active from intake through outcome; target changes require a successor or explicit perimeter change.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Required before screening completion.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Consumed by every analytical and execution workstream.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An organization participates in a deal in a defined role such as sponsor, seller, buyer, lender, adviser, or administrator.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Role and effective period are represented by RoleAssignment.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Identity and source roles support intake, access, diligence, financing, and exit.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Consumed by source ingestion, sponsor assessment, financing, legal, and execution.
relationships.authority_relevance: Authority exists only through roles or agreements.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material conflicts or eligibility issues can block.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A deal is allocated to one or more legal or accounting vehicles.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Proposed at screening; approved before commitment; retained through archive.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Vehicle eligibility is required before approval and commitment.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Eligibility or concentration breach blocks allocation.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A deal may create one or more vehicle-security exposures.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Created after approval and closing; may persist through partial outcomes.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Required for live monitoring and outcome.
relationships.permission_relevance: Exposure inherits deal and vehicle policies.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Exposure size and downside affect approval and triggers.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An investment exposure is held or committed by exactly one vehicle.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Fixed for the exposure identity; transfer creates a successor exposure.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Required for closing and administration.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An investment exposure obtains its economics and rights from one security or instrument.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Fixed for the exposure identity; material term change is represented by a security version or successor exposure.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Required before valuation, decision, and closing.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An exposure has zero or more as-of position snapshots.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Begins at or after closing and continues until residual exposure is eliminated.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds monitoring, re-underwriting, and outcome.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A deal instantiates workstreams as required by state, archetype, risk, and materiality.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Runs may be planned, active, completed, reopened, waived, or cancelled.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Primary execution link between deal state and workstream graph.
relationships.authority_relevance: Waiver and completion overrides require authority.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material missing outputs block relevant gates.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A run implements one version of a reusable workstream definition.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Definition version is fixed at instantiation unless migrated through an explicit event.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Determines start, done, and dependency behavior.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An actor may hold multiple scoped roles over time.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Assignments are time-bounded and append-only.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Determines ownership, access, and authority.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An organization may hold multiple deal or entity roles over time.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Assignments are time-bounded.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Supports sponsor, seller, lender, adviser, and administrator roles.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Source, sponsor, financing, legal, and administration workstreams.
relationships.permission_relevance: Policies may depend on organizational role.
relationships.authority_relevance: Contractual authority may attach to organization roles.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A role assignment may be scoped to one deal.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Effective only within its date range.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Determines deal ownership and approval eligibility.

relationships.relationship_name: Access Grant controls Source Material Set
relationships.source_independent_definition: An access grant authorizes use of one or more material sets within its scope.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Grant must be active when confidential material is received or used.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Blocks source ingestion when absent, denied, revoked, or expired.
relationships.materiality_relevance: No investment materiality; access result blocks use.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A permission policy may govern actions on document artifacts based on role, classification, and context.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Only active policy versions apply; policy evaluation is time-aware.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Evaluated whenever a document action is requested.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: All workstreams that consume or produce documents.
relationships.authority_relevance: Policy activation and override require governance authority.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Access denial blocks the attempted action but does not resolve investment materiality.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An authority rule specifies the approval or override requirements for a gate.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Rule version is fixed for a gate activation cycle.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Controls transition authorization.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Threshold rule may escalate approver requirements.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An approval record evidences an authority decision under one rule version.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Immutable and time-stamped.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: May satisfy or fail a gate condition.

relationships.source_independent_definition: One or more approval records authorize or reject a decision.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Required before a decision becomes effective.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Controls decision gate and downstream action.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Higher materiality may require additional approvals.

relationships.relationship_name: Source Material Set belongs to Deal
relationships.source_independent_definition: A material set is scoped to one deal.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Retained through archive subject to policy.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Provides source-case inputs.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A material set contains zero or more logical documents.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Membership is versioned until the set is finalized.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Supports indexing and workstream input discovery.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A logical document has one or more immutable content versions.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: New content creates a successor version.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Decisions and evidence reference exact versions.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An evidence item may be captured from a precise document version and locator.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Evidence retains the source version permanently.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Supports reproducible decisions and model inputs.
relationships.permission_relevance: Intersection of evidence and source permissions.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Source reliability influences whether evidence can satisfy blockers.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An evidence item is evaluated within one deal context.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Supports questions, assumptions, findings, decisions, and monitoring.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A deal may have multiple versioned question-register snapshots.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Active during diligence and may reopen during monitoring or re-underwriting.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Controls question planning and decision readiness.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Question engine and all diligence workstreams.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Critical open questions block relevant gates.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A register version contains zero or more questions.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Decision snapshots freeze membership and status.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Routes work and controls readiness.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A question may test one or more assumptions, and an assumption may be tested by multiple questions.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Persists until the question is resolved, reframed, or retired.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Creates workstream tasks and may block decisioning.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Critical questions linked to material assumptions block or require acceptance.

relationships.source_independent_definition: Evidence may increase support for an assumption.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Relationship is immutable for a given evidence and assumption version.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Enables assumption status and model readiness.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Support sufficiency is evaluated by materiality and reliability.

relationships.source_independent_definition: Evidence may challenge or break an assumption.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Relationship is immutable for a given evidence and assumption version.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: May reopen questions, block valuation, or trigger re-underwriting.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A risk may threaten one or more value-creation claims in a thesis.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Active while the risk can affect the thesis.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds screening, diligence, decisioning, monitoring, and re-underwriting.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Question engine and all analytical workstreams.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material unmitigated risk can block or trigger acceptance.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A thesis is supported by one or more explicit assumptions.

relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds screening, valuation, decisioning, and monitoring.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Broken material assumptions break or reframe the thesis.

relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds models, monitoring, and re-underwriting.

relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Provides decision-basis traceability.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A finding may answer, reframe, or leave unresolved a question.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A finding may support, challenge, break, or supersede an assumption.

relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds model and decision readiness.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material change can block or trigger.

relationships.materiality_relevance: Missing measurement for a material initiative warns or blocks reliance.

relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Direct engine consequence.

relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Direct state-machine control.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A decision references the question-register snapshot used at the decision time.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Decision freezes the register version.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Shows unresolved questions and acceptances at the gate.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Critical open questions require acceptance or block.

relationships.materiality_relevance: Acceptance does not erase the underlying risk.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A risk-acceptance record may accept one residual risk.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Acceptance is time-bounded and scope-specific.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Allows continuation where permitted.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Expiry or material change reopens risk.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An exception may waive or defer a specific gate requirement.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Effective only within stated scope and period.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Allows controlled unhappy-path progression.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An execution set contains zero or more legal agreements required for the transaction.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Signed-set snapshot freezes agreement versions.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Supports signing and closing.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Legal, structuring, financing, transaction documentation, closing.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A legal agreement may create, issue, amend, or govern one or more securities.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Executed agreement version governs the security terms.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Required for signing, closing, monitoring, and amendment.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Term inconsistency blocks closing or triggers revaluation.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A legal agreement may contain zero or more covenants.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Covenant terms version with the agreement.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds financing, closing, monitoring, and re-underwriting.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A legal agreement may grant governance and information rights.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Rights remain active while the agreement and conditions remain effective.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds approval, closing, monitoring, and exit.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Loss of a material right may block or trigger.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A closing record confirms one signed execution-document set.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Fixed at closing.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Enables transition to live monitoring.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Incomplete material documents block closed status.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A closing may create one or more live investment exposures.

relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Creates monitoring objects.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Mismatch between approved and created exposure blocks reconciliation.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A capital event changes the economic state of one exposure.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Immutable event ledger.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Updates positions and outcomes.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A monitoring record contains one or more period observations.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Monitoring snapshot freezes observation references.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Supports variance analysis and trigger detection.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A monitoring record may compare actuals against an approved model-case baseline.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Baseline reference is fixed for the monitoring version.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Tests original underwriting.

relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Trigger remains linked to the source snapshot.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Moves or reopens the deal into re-underwriting.
relationships.authority_relevance: Dismissal of critical triggers may require authority.

relationships.source_independent_definition: One or more validated triggers initiate a re-underwriting cycle.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Triggers are fixed inputs to the review cycle.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Activates re-underwriting.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material or critical validated trigger requires action.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A re-underwriting record compares current evidence with the original or prior approved model case.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Baseline reference is immutable for the review.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Preserves original decision basis.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material deviations drive options and decision.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A re-underwriting record may confirm, break, or supersede assumptions.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Updates create status events or successor assumptions.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds revised model and decision.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A re-underwriting record may produce a hold, follow-on, rescue, restructure, sell, impairment, or no-action decision.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Decision is linked when submitted or effective.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Routes to monitoring, execution, closing, or exit.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material trigger requires explicit decision or rationale for no action.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A decision may authorize or record an outcome.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Outcome references the effective decision where applicable.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Closes or updates the outcome loop.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Residual exposure determines whether monitoring remains open.

relationships.source_independent_definition: Capital events provide economic realization, impairment, or write-off evidence for outcomes.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Outcome aggregates immutable events.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Supports final outcome and archive.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Unreconciled material proceeds block final status.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An outcome may close, partially close, restructure, or keep a deal open.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Final outcome changes deal status while preserving prior states.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Controls exit, monitoring continuation, or archive.
relationships.authority_relevance: Outcome must be authorized where required.

relationships.relationship_name: Value Creation Plan has Synergy Plan

relationships.materiality_relevance: Material synergy claims require evidence and plan ownership.

relationships.relationship_name: Synergy Plan realized by Integration Plan

relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Integration plan may begin before closing and continue post-close.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Connects underwriting to monitoring.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Missed milestones reduce synergy confidence and may trigger.

relationships.relationship_name: Value Creation Plan has Add-on Pipeline

relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Pipeline is active while M&A is part of the value-creation plan.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds model, decision, and monitoring.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A platform-add-on link identifies exactly one platform company.

relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Supports portfolio structure and integration.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A platform-add-on link identifies exactly one add-on company.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Fixed for the link identity.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Supports portfolio structure and integration.

relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Blocks final model and execution when unresolved.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A transition-service agreement supports operating dependencies arising from a separation perimeter.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Active through service exit or termination.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds closing and post-close monitoring.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Missing material service blocks or triggers.

relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Decision-basis version is fixed in model cases.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Blocks final valuation if missing or unresolved.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material unverified costs require downside or block.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A founder rollover is implemented through one continuing security.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Terms fixed at execution; economics tracked through events.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds structure, valuation, closing, and monitoring.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An auction process may issue process materials and data-room sets.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Material sets are tied to process round and access.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds access, ingestion, and diligence.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Loss of access may stall or terminate.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A vendor-diligence package is distributed within one source-material set.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Package updates create successor versions.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds buyer diligence and questions.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A public-market transaction may require one or more holder approvals.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Approval is required before the relevant closing condition.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: External gate before closing or realization.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A sponsor track record may create or mitigate sponsor-execution risk.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Assessment remains current only for its effective period.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds screening, diligence, and decisioning.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material losses, attribution uncertainty, or team change affect approval.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A key-person dependency is represented as or linked to a risk object for decision and monitoring purposes.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Dependency status and risk status remain linked.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds screening, decision, monitoring, and re-underwriting.
relationships.authority_relevance: Acceptance of critical dependency requires authority.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material unmitigated dependency warns, conditions, or triggers.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A deal-scoped document is associated with exactly one deal unless explicitly classified as reusable reference material.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Association persists through document versions and archive.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Enables retrieval by deal and state.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Document association alone has no materiality consequence.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A document may identify the organization responsible for producing or issuing it.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Producer attribution is immutable for a document artifact.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Supports source-provenance and reliance decisions.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Source ingestion and all evidence-consuming workstreams.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Source role and reliability affect whether represented claims can satisfy blockers.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A document may present one or more thesis versions without becoming the thesis object itself.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Relationship references the thesis version represented by a document version.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Supports source-case ingestion and decision-package assembly.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Source ingestion, screening, valuation, and decisioning.
relationships.permission_relevance: Intersection of document and thesis policies.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Represented claims require evidence before they become accepted assumptions.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A finalized screening assessment produces a proceed, decline, defer, or exception-proceed decision record.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Created when screening is finalized.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Controls transition from screening to planning or termination.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Critical fit or constraint failures determine the decision.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A model case produces forecast, target, stress, or re-underwritten metric observations.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Outputs are immutable for the model-case version.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds valuation, decisioning, monitoring baseline, and re-underwriting.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material outputs require supported inputs and model review.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A permission policy may govern actions on deal records and their inherited object scope.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Only active policy versions apply.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Evaluated on deal-object actions.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A workstream run may produce a decision-relevant input for valuation or return analysis.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Input retains the producing run and evidence lineage.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds underwriting and decision readiness.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Financial, commercial, operational, tax, financing, structuring, and valuation.
relationships.permission_relevance: Workstream, evidence, and valuation policies intersect.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material inputs must be verified or risk-accepted.

relationships.source_independent_definition: Financing, structuring, tax, or legal work may propose or revise security terms before execution.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Proposed terms remain versioned until agreed and executed.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds valuation, decisioning, and transaction documentation.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Financing, structuring, tax, legal, and valuation.
relationships.authority_relevance: Agreed terms require investment and legal authority.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material term changes require revaluation and may reopen approval.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A bridge analysis may decompose thesis value drivers, operating change, or entry-to-exit value into quantified components.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Relationship is fixed for the referenced thesis and bridge versions.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Supports diligence, valuation, decisioning, monitoring, and outcome attribution.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Financial, commercial, operational, valuation, monitoring, and exit.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Unexplained material components create questions or reduce decision readiness.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A synergy plan may provide timing, cost, and value assumptions to one or more model cases.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Model case freezes the synergy-plan version used.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds underwriting and post-close baseline.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Commercial, operational, valuation, monitoring, and re-underwriting.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material synergy value requires evidence, owner, timing, and cost treatment.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An add-on pipeline may support a buy-and-build thesis, subject to probability and execution constraints.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Active while acquisition activity remains part of the thesis.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Feeds underwriting, decisioning, and monitoring.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Commercial, operational, financing, valuation, and monitoring.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Uncommitted targets cannot be treated as certain value.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An effective exception may waive, defer, or alter one specifically identified gate condition.
relationships.lifecycle_constraints: Applies only within its effective period and stated scope.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Changes gate evaluation without deleting the original rule.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A deal owns an append-only sequence of workflow events.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: All state and transition changes create events.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A staleness record identifies a downstream representation or analytical object that must be recomputed or reviewed.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Blocks use of stale final outputs.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An approval may impose one or more explicit, testable conditions.
relationships.authority_relevance: Conditions are part of immutable authority basis.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A gate may require conditions to be satisfied or explicitly waived.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Gate satisfaction consumes condition status.

relationships.source_independent_definition: Evidence supports satisfaction, failure, or waiver evaluation of a condition.
A permission policy is evaluated for a role assignment, object, and requested action.
A permission evaluation applies to one contextual role assignment.
A contextual role assignment instantiates an effective role definition.
relationships.authority_relevance: Authority derives from contextual assignment, not global identity.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A delegation record transfers listed actions within a bounded scope and period to a receiving assignment.
relationships.authority_relevance: Delegated authority remains scoped and auditable.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A recusal excludes a contextual role assignment from specified governance actions.
relationships.authority_relevance: Conflicted actors do not participate in approval or quorum.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A dissent record preserves a reasoned disagreement with a collective decision.
relationships.authority_relevance: Dissent remains immutable with the decision.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A question may have phase-specific sufficiency assessments over its evidence set.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Controls question resolution and gate readiness.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A reasoning record identifies the evidence used in an analytical transformation.
A reasoning record produces one or more findings.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Findings feed assumptions, risks, models, and decisions.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A reasoning record may create, support, challenge, reject, or supersede an assumption.
relationships.workstream_dependency_relevance: Assumption lineage drives model and staleness behavior.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A model reasoning record may produce a versioned model case.
A valuation reasoning record may produce a versioned valuation case.

relationships.relationship_name: Covenant is tested by Metric Observation
relationships.source_independent_definition: A covenant is evaluated against one or more metric observations.
relationships.materiality_relevance: A material breach triggers re-underwriting or authority action.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A monitoring record may evaluate covenant compliance and headroom.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Covenant breach may trigger re-underwriting.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A covenant breach or headroom deterioration may create a re-underwriting trigger.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Connects monitoring to re-underwriting.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A founder rollover may carry explicit governance rights and retained influence.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Rights and alignment affect structure and decisioning.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A key-person dependency concerns one or more contextual management or sponsor role assignments.
relationships.materiality_relevance: Material dependence becomes a monitored risk.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A decision identifies the exact model-case version used as its approved basis.
A decision identifies the exact valuation-case version used as its approved basis.
A decision identifies the assumption versions relied upon.
relationships.authority_relevance: Later assumption versions do not overwrite the earlier basis.

relationships.source_independent_definition: Monitoring compares actual evidence against an immutable approved decision baseline.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Tests original underwriting.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A re-underwriting record may support a successor decision without overwriting the prior decision.
relationships.workflow_transition_relevance: Closes the outcome-calibration loop.

relationships.source_independent_definition: A changed assumption creates staleness records for affected downstream objects.
An authority action includes permission evaluations proving the actor may perform the action.
relationships.permission_relevance: Permission is checked separately from authority.

relationships.source_independent_definition: An approval records recusals that affected participation or quorum.
An approval may record dissent from collective participants.
An approval authorizes a scoped delegation where delegation is permitted.
relationships.authority_relevance: Delegation cannot arise from permission administration alone.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A short opportunity summary used to establish initial relevance and access interest.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Supports intake and initial screening; not decision-sufficient.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: An agreement governing receipt and permitted use of non-public information.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: May block confidential ingestion until executed or waived.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A document specifying process rounds, deadlines, access, bid requirements, and seller expectations.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Shapes workflow timing and external gates.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A seller- or sponsor-prepared presentation of the business, market, financials, transaction, and investment case.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Primary source-case input; claims require independent validation.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A management-led presentation of business performance, strategy, organization, market, and forecast.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Informs diligence and management assessment; not authoritative without corroboration.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A sponsor-prepared case covering transaction structure, thesis, value creation, risks, and returns.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Provides the sponsor case to test, not the final investor decision basis.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A structured plan linking initiatives, owners, timing, metrics, and economic impact.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Material drivers feed model cases and post-close monitoring.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A sponsor-owned analytical model containing management or sponsor scenarios, transaction assumptions, and returns.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Provides a source case that must be independently reviewed or rebuilt.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: Financial statements, trial balances, budgets, customer-level data, debt, working-capital, or cash-flow evidence.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Feeds financial diligence, normalization, model, and valuation.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: Customer, pricing, retention, pipeline, market, competitor, product, or channel evidence.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Feeds market and revenue assumptions.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: Organization, facilities, systems, production, service-delivery, supplier, project, or operating evidence.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Feeds execution feasibility, capex, and operational assumptions.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: Corporate, contractual, tax, regulatory, employment, insurance, litigation, or ownership evidence.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Feeds legal, tax, structuring, and signing gates.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A scoped review of earnings quality, accounting, cash flow, debt, and working capital.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Material findings and accepted adjustments feed final valuation.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A scoped review of market, customers, competitors, pricing, growth, and commercial durability.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Tests market and revenue assumptions.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A scoped review of operations, systems, capex, supply chain, delivery capability, and execution feasibility.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Tests feasibility and informs value-creation plans.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A scoped review of legal rights, liabilities, authority, contracts, litigation, and regulatory matters.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Material legal findings may block signing or require protection.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A scoped review of tax exposure, structure, leakage, filing, and jurisdictional consequences.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Material tax effects modify structure, economics, or approval.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A preliminary assessment recording fit, initial thesis, risks, questions, and resource-allocation decision.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Creates the explicit proceed, defer, decline, or exception rationale.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A structured challenge of the assumptions required for an investment to work and the counterevidence against them.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Supports challenge and negative underwriting; optional as a separate artifact.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A structured list of questions, owners, evidence needs, answers, and unresolved decision implications.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Critical unresolved questions may block decisioning.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: Notes capturing statements, questions, answers, and commitments from a diligence or monitoring interaction.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Supports evidence and question resolution; reliability depends on source and corroboration.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A record of external observations about management, sponsor, customers, or market participants.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Tests execution, reputation, and key-person assumptions.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: Investor-assembled market, company, comparable, or public-source research.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Corroborates or challenges source claims.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: An investor-controlled model used to reconstruct operating, cash-flow, security, valuation, and return cases.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Core quantitative decision input.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A decision package presenting recommendation, evidence, valuation, risks, unresolved issues, conditions, and requested authority.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Represents the basis for an authority decision; the approval event creates the effective decision.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A current analysis comparing actual evidence with the original case and evaluating hold, follow-on, rescue, restructure, sell, impairment, or no action.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Central outcome-calibration input; not inherently an exit document.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A decision package evaluating sale, realization, hold, or residual exposure under current evidence and market terms.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Supports exit or hold authority and outcome closure.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: An agreement forming or governing a fund, vehicle, feeder, blocker, or special-purpose entity.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Creates the legal vehicle and investor rights required for execution.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: Financing terms, commitments, agreements, covenant schedules, and funds-flow materials.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Material to leverage, liquidity, signing, and closing.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: The principal agreement governing acquisition, sale, consideration, representations, covenants, conditions, and remedies.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Hard legal blocker before signing and closing.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: An agreement defining ownership, board, information, transfer, consent, and protective rights.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Material to control, monitoring access, and downside protection.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A control view of required documents, conditions, approvals, funds flow, and responsibilities for closing.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Operational control; represents rather than replaces the underlying objects.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A formal notice requiring a vehicle or investor to fund a specified amount by a specified date.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Creates a pending funding event subject to confirmation.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A formal notice of proceeds or cash distribution.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Creates or evidences a proceeds event.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A period statement of commitment, cost, value, proceeds, and capital-account activity.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Represents a position view; does not replace event-level records.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: Board materials or minutes recording operating performance, decisions, risks, governance actions, and management plans.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: High-value monitoring evidence; may create triggers or actions.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: Periodic sponsor reporting on company performance, valuation, value creation, risks, and capital activity.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Feeds monitoring but retains source provenance and verification status.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A focused update on operating metrics, pipeline, sales, utilization, project, or other company performance indicators.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Feeds monitoring and re-underwriting triggers.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A calculation, memo, report, or confirmation supporting a current or transaction valuation.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Supports decision or monitoring valuation; methodology and source must remain explicit.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A multi-position model aggregating capital events, valuations, commitments, and returns.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Portfolio control and reporting; not a deal-level underwriting object.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A cross-position review of performance, risks, actions, realization outlook, and concentration.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Represents a governance view across positions.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A structured response describing an investment organization, strategy, process, team, controls, terms, and track record.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Supports sponsor assessment and onboarding.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A seller-commissioned diligence package distributed to prospective buyers.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Accelerates diligence but does not replace buyer validation.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: An agreement documenting temporary services, fees, service levels, term, and exit milestones for a separated business.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Material carve-out execution and monitoring object.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: Materials supporting or recording a required holder vote or consent for a public-market transaction.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: Represents an external closing gate.

document_type_taxonomy.source_independent_definition: A record supporting routine administration, identity, payment, tax form, invoice, or operational filing without independent investment reasoning.
document_type_taxonomy.decision_relevance: May support controls but normally represents a view or evidence rather than a new investment-domain object.

extension_points.why_needed: Sponsor quality and alignment influence reliance on the lead investor and adverse-selection risk.
extension_points.activation_condition: A lead sponsor controls diligence, governance, or reporting.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile applies a consistent rule for attribution and comparability rules.

extension_points.why_needed: Lead-sponsored processes often supply pre-commissioned diligence that must retain source and scope limitations.
extension_points.activation_condition: Seller or sponsor supplies adviser work to co-investors.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies reliance and refresh requirements.

extension_points.why_needed: Team history, attribution, realized outcomes, and strategy relevance are decision-critical.
extension_points.activation_condition: Sponsor institutional history is limited or newly organized.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies attributable versus firm-level track record.

extension_points.why_needed: Execution may depend heavily on a small number of individuals.
extension_points.activation_condition: Sponsor capacity or relationship access is concentrated.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies capacity, succession, and bandwidth fields.

extension_points.why_needed: The operating business does not exist as a fully independent historical entity.
extension_points.activation_condition: Transaction separates a business from a parent or shared platform.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies asset, liability, employee, system, and permit subtypes.

extension_points.why_needed: Temporary services may be required to operate after closing.
extension_points.activation_condition: Material shared services continue after closing.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies service-level breach and exit-milestone events.

extension_points.why_needed: Historical reported costs do not equal independent operating costs.
extension_points.activation_condition: Reported financials include allocations or omitted standalone functions.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies cost-allocation confidence and actualization controls.

extension_points.why_needed: Continuing founder ownership affects alignment, dilution, governance, and exit.
extension_points.activation_condition: A founder or family owner reinvests proceeds.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies multiple founders and family holding vehicles.

extension_points.why_needed: Founder retention, control, succession, and minority protections require explicit rights.
extension_points.activation_condition: Founder or family retains ownership, management, or control.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies succession and reserved-matter extensions.

extension_points.why_needed: Customer, operational, or cultural value may depend on the founder.
extension_points.activation_condition: Business performance or relationships depend on a founder role.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies transition and replacement milestones.

extension_points.why_needed: Competitive rounds, process rules, and limited access shape timing and diligence.
extension_points.activation_condition: Sale is run as a competitive process.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies bilateral sponsor transfers outside formal auctions.

extension_points.why_needed: Seller-sponsored diligence is a primary input but requires buyer challenge.
extension_points.activation_condition: Vendor reports or sell-side analyses are provided.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies stale-report and scope-gap treatment.

extension_points.why_needed: Public price, premium, approvals, financing certainty, and market conditions add external gates.
extension_points.activation_condition: Target or transaction is subject to public-market rules or mechanics.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies add jurisdiction-specific extensions without changing core.

extension_points.why_needed: Holder approval may be a hard external condition to closing.
extension_points.activation_condition: Applicable law or transaction structure requires a vote or consent.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies vote thresholds and competing proposal events.

extension_points.why_needed: Incremental capital requires a fresh comparison of current evidence with the original case.
extension_points.activation_condition: Existing exposure faces a new capital need, covenant issue, or restructuring.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile applies a consistent rule for old-money versus new-money option schema.

extension_points.why_needed: Existing and incremental exposures must remain separately identifiable.
extension_points.activation_condition: New money has different economics, priority, or risk.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies blended-return and cross-default relationships.

extension_points.why_needed: Breach, waiver, or cure may determine timing, structure, and downside.
extension_points.activation_condition: Debt or preferred terms include material covenants.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies waiver economics and lender-control events.

extension_points.why_needed: The thesis may depend on future acquisitions whose probability and economics vary.
extension_points.activation_condition: M&A is an explicit value driver.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies target-level probability and stage taxonomy.

extension_points.why_needed: Acquisition value depends on cost, revenue, timing, and implementation assumptions.
extension_points.activation_condition: Add-on economics include synergies.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies double-counting and standalone-versus-synergy boundaries.

extension_points.why_needed: Synergy realization requires executable post-close work.
extension_points.activation_condition: Platform and add-on operations must be combined.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies milestone and dependency event model.

extension_points.why_needed: Portfolio structure must distinguish platform and add-on company identities.
extension_points.activation_condition: A company is acquired into an existing platform.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies multi-platform and subsequent divestiture cases.

extension_points.why_needed: Unusual structures should be represented through explicit exceptions rather than hidden model changes.
extension_points.activation_condition: A process or object does not fit a configured archetype.
configuration_requirements: The extension profile specifies promote repeated patterns into a new extension only after stable identity and lifecycle emerge.

authority_actions: Revive a terminated or stalled process
